lessons.lesson: A persistent bearish sweep in a SHORT-GAMMA name with a live bullish catalyst (e.g. IPO access) + a fundamentals VETO is a trap: a ZGL reclaim squeezes UP. The 21D-window confirmation shows the short was never rehabilitated -- the fade from the 108.15 peak to 99.96 stayed ~21% above entry and never threatened the 80/77.5 targets. Still CANDIDATE: this is the same trade re-marked at a later window, not a distinct second trade; promotion to ACTIVE needs another name showing the pattern.
Reinforced again by the HOOD 21D window (LOSS, still +21% against at review): a DIVERGENT flow<->chart read is not a directional trade. The watch-only / 0% directional decision remains correct.
